analysis:
The only changes in docs/provider/cli-reference.md are documentation. Head lines 584-589 add scheduler-prefill benchmark schema 5 fields (prefillChunkTokens, maxBatchedTokensPerStep, soloPrefillStripeTokens) and state that a measured engine built with different geometry fails the run. A new env-var table row (head ~1759) lists DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS with source pointers. The patch is truncated, so I could not see its tail, but the provided range map is complete.

No code, auth, attestation, encryption, cache-storage or billing behavior changes in the supplied evidence. The benchmark fields are non-sensitive scheduler geometry. The new env knobs affect engine scheduling and availability only. They are not forwarded to the coordinator and do not touch the prefix-cache crypto, TTL, HMAC naming or salt scoping in T-041, or any trust boundary. Surrounding unchanged docs (logout revocation, GLM local qualification, cache storage) are consistent with the threat model, and I identified no new regression there.

Remaining question for integration: the actual source for the DARKBLOOM_CBV2_PREFILL_CHUNK and DARKBLOOM_CBV2_STEP_TOKENS overrides (EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift) was not supplied. Whether they can be set in the launchd environment, and whether they bound values safely against memory-admission or DoS (T-010/T-029 class), cannot be verified from this docs-only change. This is a note, not a finding.
